scope: Static artistic inspection of three new integrated whole-character returns, their white-alpha QA images, source pose/costume references and F858 eye-rendering reference
current_rule: Use integrated whole-character redraws. Do not continue separate head/body/cap collage or manual seam repairs.
eye_rule: F858 controls rendering only: bold black upper line, dark charcoal iris and small simple highlights. Each current source frame controls eye openness, gaze and expression.

coherent_features: cap and black accessory attached to crown
recognizable original black/white maid costume and large back waist bow
two red beads and one continuous gray/mint drill on the correct side
frames.main_issue: Source eyes are relatively round and open in a look-back expression. The new drawing imports F858's lowered half-open eyelid state and reads more tired/downcast.
frames.single_next_direction: Redraw the integrated whole character while preserving its coherent costume/pose/hair construction and restoring F1501 source open-eye look-back expression. F858 supplies rendering, not eyelid openness.

frames.source_pose_observation: Right-facing seated profile, hanging crossed lower legs and visible hand beside skirt remain coherent with source.
frames.costume_observation: Black high-collar long-sleeve maid dress, white shoulder frills/apron/cuff/long back ties and side-visible red chest bow remain recognizable and coherent.
frames.head_connection_observation: Cap rests on crown; neck naturally enters black collar; no obvious floating accessory or collage cutoff.
frames.hair_observation: Gray short bob, two beads and one continuous gray/mint drill behind visible profile on image left; complete middle and tapering tip.
frames.eye_observation: Bold upper line, narrow dark gray profile iris and simple light mark are compatible with F858 and retain current source eye direction/openness.

frames.source_pose_observation: Rear three-quarter cropped-shoulder view remains coherent.
frames.costume_observation: Black high collar, white shoulder frills and diagonal apron straps remain coherent with original maid design.
frames.head_connection_observation: Cap and connected black two-leaf accessory are attached to crown; neck/collar connection is cohesive and no old collage seam is visible.
frames.hair_observation: Rounded gray bob, two red beads and a complete continuous single gray/mint drill on image left; no side flip or broken middle.
frames.eye_observation: A small side eye exposed by replacing the original longer side hair with a short bob is a plausible occlusion difference, not a clear camera mismatch. Its rendering is compatible with F858. Do not force additional eye visibility onto a rear view.

nonblocking_style_limits: F1501 has richer grouped hair highlights and cloth shading than the other two
All three are smoother and somewhat more illustration-like than the original PV
Small line/shading variations alone were not treated as a redraw failure
not_verified: F1501 hand contact with separately composited bucket/handle
supersedes: Do not use the previous v01 old-composite matte/pixel repair recommendations as the next drawing route.
